title: Focusing on the New Ecosystem of Intelligent Packaging Manufacturing | CYCJET Cordially Invites You to interpack 2026 in Germany-Женская мода, модные журналы, модные тренды, модные бренды
text:
2026-04-29 Interpack 2026, a highly anticipated event for the global packaging industry, is about to kick off in Düsseldorf, Germany! As a globally recognized flagship exhibition for the packaging industry, Interpack is not only a stage for showcasing technology and innovation, but also a core hub for understanding future trends and connecting global business opportunities.
As a renowned brand in industrial inkjet and laser marking, CYCJET has been invited to exhibit for the first time. At Booth H17-3 in Hall 8B, the company will comprehensively showcase its marking solutions—specifically tailored to the packaging industry—while simultaneously launching a global recruitment program for high-caliber distributors to jointly expand into the global inkjet marking market.
With over 20 years of deep expertise in the coding and marking industry, we empower global packaging through innovation.
CYCJET is a national-level high-tech enterprise backed by over two decades of accumulated expertise. Integrating R&D, manufacturing, and sales, the company holds numerous core patents as well as international certifications such as CE, FDA, and SGS, with its services reaching over 100 countries and regions worldwide. Addressing critical pain points within the packaging industry—such as poor adhesion, illegible markings, and difficulties in traceability—CYCJET offers highly adaptable solutions that are widely deployed across sectors including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and electronics, thereby helping clients reduce costs and enhance operational efficiency.
（CYCJET Cordially Invites You to interpack 2026 in Germany）
At this exhibition, CYCJET will prominently showcase a comprehensive portfolio of marking and coding products centered around its h igh- s p eed d igital i nkjet p rinting s ystem . Concurrently, the company will display a diverse range of equipment—including l aser m arking m achine s eries , B-Series CIJ i nkjet p rinters , and thermal transfer overprinter—thereby comprehensively addressing production requirements ranging from basic coding to advanced marking applications. 1. H igh- s peed d igital i nkjet p rinting s ystem : Supports multi-line, large-format printing—achieving a maximum resolution of 2400 DPI through multi-head configurations—making it ideal for high-density information such as ingredient lists and traceability codes. It accommodates various ink types and color printing, and is compatible with substrates such as flexible plastic packaging and paper cartons; furthermore, it can be integrated with vision inspection systems to enable real-time verification.
2. Laser printer s eries : This series covers various types including fiber, CO₂, and UV lasers. At this exhibition, we will highlight the LU5Tmini UV laser printer, which is compact, lower in cost, easier to integrate into production lines, and easier to install. It meets the needs of most packaging materials, roll film, high-speed production lines, and long-term use scenarios, aiming to provide customers with better choices and achieve cost reduction and efficiency improvement in different scenarios.
3. B-SeriesCIJ Inkjet Printers: As a mature product within the field of industrial marking, this series offers exceptional cost-effectiveness and broad applicability, making it ideally suited for distributors looking to expand their local market presence. Consequently, CYCJET has launched an OEM service designed to assist CIJ inkjet distributors worldwide in establishing their own independent brands. Simultaneously, we have introduced a flexible consumables supply model, providing distributors with a more adaptable sales framework that fundamentally enhances their market competitiveness.
4. Thermal transfer overprinter: Suitable for almost all flexible packaging, with large amounts of variable data, quick switching between different printing jobs, stable printing, low price and consumable costs, supports operating system and appearance OEM customization, suitable for large, medium and small enterprises and global TTO distributors, meeting the production needs of enterprises and the market expansion of distributors.
Deep Empowerment: Global Distributor Recruitment Program
CYCJET's ability to cultivate the signage industry for over 20 years is inseparable from the strong support of its global partners. During Interpack 2026, we will officially launch the "Global Partner Growth Program," focusing on recruiting high-quality distributors in Europe, the Americas, and emerging markets.
What can we offer? 1.Product Competitiveness: Balancing Performance and Cost 2.OEM Customization Services: Empowering Independent Brand Building 3.Comprehensive Supply Chain: One-Stop Supply for Complete Units and Consumables 4.Market Protection & Profit Margins: Exclusive Regional Agency Protection 5.Localized Support: Free Training, Production Line Guidance, and Joint Marketing—Low Entry Barriers, Rapid Launch, and Stable Profitability
Exhibition Guide and Exclusive Services
Exhibition Information: Exhibition Name: Interpack 2026
Exhibition Dates: May 7-13, 2026 Exhibition Venue: Düsseldorf Exhibition Center, Germany CYCJET Booth Number: Hall 8b, H17-3
During the event, the CYCJET booth will offer the following exclusive services: 1.Pre-scheduled booth appointments 2.One-on-one consultations for customized solutions 3.On-site equipment demonstrations and exclusive offers
With over 20 years of experience in the coding and printing industry, CYCJET helps the global packaging sector reduce costs, boost efficiency, and endow products with higher added value. See you in Germany!
